SYNTHESIZED — no real Pi agent transcript was available on this machine.

This fixture mimics the native shape of `<data_dir>/.pi/agent/sessions/<cwd-slug>/<session>.jsonl`
as written by the Pi coding agent: one JSON object per line, each with `type`,
`cwd`, `session`, `version`, and `timestamp`, plus per-type fields — `message`
records carry `role` (`user` | `assistant`), `content` text, and (assistant
only) `model`, `reasoning`, and token `usage`; `tool_call` records carry `name`
and `input`; `tool_result` records carry `tool`, `output`, and `is_error`;
`subagent_start` / `subagent_end` records carry `subagent_id` and `task`; and
`summary` records carry compaction context in `summary`. Field names follow the
documented Pi session format; session ids, token counts, and prose are
invented. It is not a captured production transcript.
